items: 2–5 Anaheim chiles or 3 jalapeños, stemmed, seeded, and finely chopped
1 × 28 oz can whole peeled tomatoes, undrained

steps.title: Cook the chiles and onion
steps.body: Heat **¼ cup olive oil** in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add **2–5 Anaheim chiles** or **3 jalapeños** and **1 small yellow onion**, and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden brown, about 6 minutes.

steps.title: Add the garlic and spices
steps.body: Add **5 cloves garlic**, crushed then sliced, **1 tsp ground cumin** and **1 Tbsp paprika**, and cook, stirring frequently, until garlic is soft, about 2 more minutes.

steps.title: Crush the tomatoes
steps.body: Put **1 × 28 oz can whole peeled tomatoes** and their liquid into a medium bowl and crush with your hands.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Add crushed tomatoes and their liquid to the skillet along with **½ cup water**, reduce heat to medium, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Season the sauce
steps.body: Season sauce with kosher salt, to taste.

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.body: Crack **6 eggs** over sauce so that eggs are evenly distributed across the sauce’s surface. Cover the skillet and cook until the yolks are just set, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Baste the whites
steps.body: Using a spoon, baste the whites of the eggs with tomato mixture, being careful not to disturb the yolk.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.body: Sprinkle shakshuka with **½ cup feta cheese**, crumbled, and **1 Tbsp chopped flat-leaf parsley**, and serve with warm pitas, for dipping.
